notes.title: A completely new game mode, new rules, new meaning!
notes.notes:
Exclusion zone Sibirsk-5... New Year's Eve stayed in this zone forever! Residents left these areas in a hurry. Usually gangs bypass this city, they say there is what you need, but also what will kill you! What happened in this city or maybe should happen?

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New game mode and new location
[*] Chat in mobile phone
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] 8Bit Hacker shop
[*] Many NPCs bugs
[*] Optimization
[*] Other bug fixes
[/list]

We also started to implement a new input system, this will allow us to support more gamepads, as well as menu controls. The result will be in next updates! Thanks for the bug reports and ideas!

notes.title: v1.501: Making game more fast, smooth and stable!
notes.notes:
[b]Today we have updated the game to version 1.501[/b]

We have fixed many lags and freezes!
- The game now supports 60+ fps. 
- Smooth movement of the player and objects. 
- High definition resolution supports! 
- And other nice improvements! 

We will also keep improvement and update game just say to us - where is game working wrong :)
